title: First Year Revenue Impact
scenario: Compare the total revenue of a product in its first year vs its total lifetime revenue. Return 'product_id', 'first_year_revenue', and 'total_revenue'.
tableSchema: sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT)
hint: Join total yearly revenue with lifetime total revenue.
correctQuery: SELECT t1.product_id, t1.rev AS first_year_revenue, t2.rev AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity * price) AS rev FROM sales WHERE (product_id, year) IN (SELECT product_id, MIN(year) FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) GROUP BY product_id) t1 JOIN (SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity * price) AS rev FROM sales GROUP BY product_id) t2 ON t1.product_id = t2.product_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE sales (sale_id INT, product_id INT, year INT, quantity INT, price INT); INSERT INTO sales VALUES (1, 100, 2008, 10, 100), (2, 100, 2009, 10, 100);
